ITEM.PTXT: The skid control computer converts the wheel speed pulse signals of 48 pulses per 1 tire revolution output from the speed sensors installed on each wheel into a vehicle speed signal and sends it to the combination meter via CAN communication. ITEM.PTXT: The meter computer receives the remaining fuel level in the fuel tank (fuel level signal) from the fuel sender gauge and calculates the fuel level display data through arithmetic processing.

Based on the calculated fuel level data, the meter computer controls the rotation angle, direction and speed of the pointer (stepper motor rotor) with the stepper motor driver circuit to indicate the remaining fuel level.
The meter computer performs initialization control that returns the pointer to the zero position each time power is supplied to the combination meter.

When the fuel level display data calculated for driving the fuel gauge decreases to a remaining fuel level of approximately 9L, the meter computer illuminates the low fuel level warning indicator light in the combination meter.
The low fuel level warning indicator light goes off when the remaining fuel level is approximately 10.5L or more.

ITEM.PTXT: A D (temporary S) mode indicator light and an S (sequential shift) mode indicator light have been provided.
When the shift position is moved to "S", the S mode indicator light "S" illuminates and the current shift range is displayed.

When an UP/DOWN shift range operation is performed with the transmission shift switch while shift position "D" is selected, the D mode indicator light "D" illuminates and the current shift range is displayed.

When the shift position "S" signal is input, the engine control computer also receives the shift switch operation (UP/DOWN) signal from the shift lever or transmission shift switch, and sends the "shift range signal" and "'S' illumination signal" to the meter computer as CAN communication signals.
Upon receiving these signals, the meter computer illuminates the S mode indicator light "S" and displays the currently selected shift range on the display LCD.

When the shift switch operation (UP/DOWN) signal from the transmission shift switch is input while the shift position "D" signal is input, the engine control computer sends the "shift range signal" and "'D' illumination signal" to the meter computer as CAN communication signals.
Upon receiving these signals, the meter computer illuminates the D mode indicator light "D" and displays the currently selected shift range on the display LCD.

MECA.TITLE: Smart Entry & Start System Warning Buzzer Specifications

ITEM.PTXT: Sounds as a single tone, intermittent tone or continuous tone in response to sounding requests from the Certification ECU and Main Body ECU.
Sounds 1 time(s) when a system malfunction warning is shown on the multi-information display.

When the vehicle speed reaches approximately 20km/h or more with the power source mode ON and the driver or front passenger seat belt unfastened, the meter computer sounds the buzzer in the combination meter to prompt the occupant to fasten the seat belt.

For approximately the first 30 seconds, the seat belt unfastened warning buzzer sounds as level 1 with an intermittent tone of 1.2-second cycle. If the seat belt is not fastened within approximately 30 seconds, the buzzer sounds as level 2 with an intermittent tone of 0.4-second cycle for approximately 90 seconds.
If the driver and front passenger seat belts are fastened while the buzzer is sounding at level 1 or 2, the buzzer stops sounding.

Even if the vehicle speed drops below approximately 20km/h while the buzzer is sounding at level 1 or level 2, the buzzer continues to sound. In addition, after the buzzer has finished sounding (120 seconds after it starts), the buzzer will not sound even if the vehicle speed drops below 20km/h and then rises to 20km/h or more again.
The buzzer stops sounding when the shift position is moved to "R".

ITEM.PTXT: When the driver seat belt is unfastened (driver seat belt inner buckle switch ON), the Main Body ECU outputs a driver seat belt unfastened warning signal to the meter computer. While receiving this signal, the meter computer sounds the buzzer when the vehicle speed signal from the skid control computer reaches approximately 20km/h or more.

LIST1.TITLE: Front Passenger Seat Belt Unfastened Warning Buzzer Operation

ITEM.PTXT: When the meter computer receives an occupant detection sensor ON and front passenger seat belt inner buckle switch ON (front passenger seat belt not fastened) signal and the vehicle speed reaches approximately 20km/h or more, it sounds the buzzer in the same way as the driver seat belt unfastened warning buzzer.
As with the driver seat belt unfastened warning buzzer, the buzzer stops when the seat belt inner buckle switch turns OFF (seat belt fastened) or the power source mode is turned OFF.

ITEM.PTXT: A seat belt warning system, which reminds the driver and front passenger to fasten their seat belts, has been adopted. The warning indicator light for the driver seat is located in the combination meter, and that for the front passenger seat is located in the air conditioning control panel.
An occupant detection sensor, which detects the presence of an occupant, has been provided under the front passenger seat cushion cover.
When the power switch is turned ON, the driver side seat belt warning indicator light starts blinking to remind the driver to fasten the seat belt.
When it is detected that the driver side seat belt has been fastened (tongue plate locked into the driver side seat belt inner buckle), the warning indicator light goes off.

TABLE.TITLE: Front Passenger Side Seat Belt Warning

ITEM.PTXT: When the occupant detection sensor detects a front passenger when the power switch is turned ON, the front passenger side seat belt warning indicator light starts blinking to remind the front passenger to fasten the seat belt.
When it is detected that the front passenger side seat belt has been fastened (tongue plate locked into the front passenger side seat belt inner buckle), the warning indicator light goes off.

ITEM.PTXT: When the power switch is ON and the driver side seat belt is not fastened (tongue plate not locked into the buckle), the main body ECU receives driver side seat belt buckle switch ON.

When the meter computer receives the driver side seat belt buckle switch ON signal from the main body ECU as a CAN communication signal, it drives the LED driver to blink the LED for the driver side seat belt warning indicator.

When the driver side seat belt is fastened (tongue plate locked into the buckle) and driver side seat belt buckle switch OFF is received, the meter computer turns off the LED for the driver side seat belt warning indicator.

TABLE.TITLE: Front Passenger Side Seat Belt Warning

ITEM.PTXT: When the power switch is ON, a front passenger is seated and the front passenger side seat belt is not fastened (tongue plate not locked into the buckle), the meter computer receives occupant detection sensor ON and front passenger side seat belt buckle switch ON. As a result, the meter computer blinks the LED for the front passenger side seat belt warning indicator.

When the occupant detection sensor turns OFF, or the front passenger side seat belt is fastened (tongue plate locked into the buckle) and front passenger side seat belt buckle switch OFF is received, the meter computer turns off the LED for the front passenger side seat belt warning indicator.
